summary: IPinfo is a REST API for IP intelligence: geolocation, ASN, anonymity/hosting/mobile flags, and more. It has a free Lite tier and paid Core/Plus/Max tiers, plus a batch endpoint of up to 1,000 lookups per request. The docs cover both a newer api.ipinfo.io schema and a legacy ipinfo.io schema.

sources.quote: IPinfo Lite uses the api.ipinfo.io API URL and /lite endpoint.

value.description: Bearer token in the Authorization header. The same API token is also accepted as a query parameter or as the HTTP Basic username. The token is on the dashboard.

sources.quote: A Bearer token in the Authorization header (Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN)

value.description: HTTP Basic with the token as the username and an empty password

sources.quote: HTTP Basic Authentication (using the token as the username, e.g. curl -u $TOKEN:)

value.purpose: Free-tier lookup returning country, continent and ASN. {ip} can be 'me' for the caller's IP. An optional /{field} suffix returns a single field.
Paid Core/Plus/Max lookup with geolocation, ASN and network flags. {ip} can be 'me'.
Batch up to 1,000 lookups or URL patterns (e.g. lite/1.1.1.1, resproxy/IP, AS number) in one request. The body is a JSON array, a newline-separated list or a space-separated list.

keyParams.description: List of IPs or URL patterns

sources.quote: The /batch API endpoint lets you group up to 1,000 IPinfo API requests into a single HTTP request.

value.purpose: Batch lookup for free-tier tokens (Lite data)
Legacy schema lookup on the host ipinfo.io, not api.ipinfo.io

value.limits: Lite is unlimited. Paid plans have a monthly request quota. There are no daily, hourly, concurrency or per-second caps on paid plans.
value.description: Exceeding the plan's monthly limit returns HTTP 429. With metered billing enabled, usage continues through overages.

sources.quote: If you exceed your plan's limit, you'll receive a 429 HTTP status code.

value.description: No version number is documented. The docs describe an updated schema on api.ipinfo.io (/lite, /lookup) alongside a legacy schema on ipinfo.io.

sources.quote: Our legacy API is still maintained with fresh data

versioning.reasoning: The docs show two parallel API generations by host and schema, with no explicit version scheme or deprecation policy.

risks.title: Two response schemas
risks.detail: The new api.ipinfo.io schema (nested geo/as) differs from the legacy ipinfo.io schema (flat city/loc, asn object). Privacy Extended data is only on the legacy route. Choose one deliberately.

risks.title: Error format undocumented
risks.detail: The pages fetched give no error body schema. Only a 429 on quota exhaustion is mentioned. Free tokens calling /lookup get an error whose shape is unspecified.

risks.title: Token exposure
risks.detail: The token is commonly passed as a query parameter, which can leak into logs. Use the Bearer header on the server side. JSONP and CORS client-side use would expose the token.

risks.title: Tier-gated endpoints
risks.detail: /lookup and most batch patterns need a paid plan. Lite is free but returns only country and ASN data.

risks.title: Monthly quota and overage billing
risks.detail: Hitting the quota returns 429 unless metered billing is on, in which case overages are billed.
